entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Anticipatory Bail Application No. 333 of 2023
Praveen Kumar Bhatt @ Praveen Bhatt ...Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ...Respondent
Present:-
Mr. Prashant Khanna, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. M.A. Khan, A.G.A. for the State.
Mr. Devang Dobhal, Advocate for the complainant.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

Applicant seeks anticipatory bail in Fir No.117 of 2024, under Sections 376, 417 & 506 Ipc and 3 of
the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, Police Station
Nehru Colony, District Dehradun.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the informant has been staying in Dehradun for the last seven years.
During that period, she came in contact with the applicant; they fell in relationship; they established physical relations.
But subsequently, according to the FIR, the applicant declined to marry.
4. Learned counsel for the informant seeks time to file objections.
5. State as well as the informant may file objections.
6. Learned counsel for the informant would submit that the applicant may be directed to supply him the copy of the anticipatory bail application within three days from now.
7. List this matter on 5.6.2024.

sentences.text:
Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing person bond, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer, subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner whatsoever, the victim or any other witness in the case.
(ii) He shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) He shall deposit his passport with the Investigating Officer ("IO").
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, if the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the IO.

(v) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i),
(ii) & (iii) above.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 16.04.2023 Ravi Praveen Kumar Bhatt @ Praveen Bhatt vs State Of Uttarakhand on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58588627/
